definitions.explanation: A prolonged debate or disagreement, especially one conducted publicly; an argument about important issues.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{論争|ろんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The controversy over this issue continues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{論争|ろんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げた→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧。
examples.english: The scholars engaged in a heated debate.
examples.notes: {論争|ろんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧ = to engage in a dispute

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治的|せいじてき}→政治的：05684_seijiteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{論争|ろんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けたい→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to avoid political controversies.

notes:
USAGE: {論争|ろんそう} refers to serious disputes or controversies, typically about intellectual, political, or social matters.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {論争|ろんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧ (to engage in a dispute)
- {論争|ろんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧ (a controversy arises)
- {論争|ろんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to cause controversy)
- {論争|ろんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{的|まと}→的：19356_mato⟧ (subject of controversy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {論争|ろんそう} - intellectual/public dispute
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧ - discussion, debate (more neutral)
- ⟦{口論|こうろん}→口論：08371_kouron⟧ - verbal quarrel (more emotional)
